'''Shen-Ji Collun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Shen-Ji Collun was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Collun took up the rank of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="FOR" />

As the war raged on, Collun's master told her that she was now two months away from undergoing the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]], and becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. In order to prepare for her trials, Collun was dispatched on a [[Mission to Daimar|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Daimar]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], which her master said would help train her further in [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]]. While on the planet, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] culminated his plans to eliminate the Jedi Order and issued [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the Grand Army, thus beginning the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. With the Republic gone and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arisen in its place, Collun was stranded on Daimar when the Imperials [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the world.<ref name="FOR" />

Feeling helpless, Collun strove to keep the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] at bay, not allowing fear or hate to consume her. Appealing to Daimar's [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]] for asylum, the monarch aided her in regaining her focus by giving her an assignment. Collun joined a group escorting [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Alet Komain]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Wilena]] to safety on the planet of [[Byrsym]], where they would meet with a rebel group led by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Torrin]], Mitar's son. The refugees soon managed to break through the Imperial blockade aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Wasaka]]'', and managed to reach Byrsym, in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Soon after, the group met with Agent [[Ballon]], who informed Collun that the prince had fled to the world of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in fear of Imperial imprisonment. Later arriving on Dantooine, the refugees found solace in the company of their prince. Collun, [[Force sense/Legends|sensing]] Princess Wilena's latent Force-sensitivity, befriended the young heiress.<ref name="FOR" />
